comment: The whole module is monophonic per side. The module's own wobble is one oscillator whose two quadrature outputs drive the two sides, YC.cpp:55-56, so the left and right delays move a quarter cycle apart. A Mod jack is scaled by the Depth knob divided by five, which is why the knob becomes an attenuator when a cable is patched. Both inputs are also configured as bypasses to their own outputs.
